ruleContent.replaceRegex:
<js>
// 转义标题变量中的特殊字符，确保正则安全
let safeTitle = title.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

// 根据标题长度动态匹配并清理正文中的重复标题行
if (title.length < 5) {
    result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*${safeTitle}\\s*\\n`, "i"), "");
} else {
    let shortTitle = safeTitle.substr(0, Math.floor(safeTitle.length * 2 / 3));
    result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*${shortTitle}.*\\n`, "i"), "");
}

// 匹配并移除以“第X章”开头的特征行，防止章节名残留
result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*第\\S+?章.{0,${title.length}}\\n`, "i"), "");

// 清理文末各种括号格式的“本章完”字样
result = result.replace(/\s*[（|(]本章完[)|）]\s*/g, "");

result;
</js>
ruleContent.title: div.page-header@text##(\(\d+?\/\d+?\))##

ruleExplore.author: tbody>tr>td:nth-of-type(4)@text
ruleExplore.coverUrl:
<js>
let bookUrl = result.select("tbody>tr>td:nth-of-type(2)>a").attr("href");
let bookId = bookUrl.match(/_(\d+)/)[1];
result = `https://m.libahao.com/data/image/${bookId}.jpg`
</js>
ruleExplore.name: tbody>tr>td:nth-of-type(2)>a@text
